I couldn't get a complete answer. The hook blocked the one command that could confirm the import statements, and it blocked it again when I repeated it, even though its message said a repeat would be allowed. I didn't work around the block with another search tool.

The stacklit index shows `autoscale.`-qualified symbols in three non-test files, so these three import the package:

internal/api/autoscale.go, internal/deploy/autoscale.go, internal/store/autoscale.go

The list may be incomplete. `internal/api/autoscale_signals.go`, `internal/api/routes_autoscale.go`, `internal/telemetry/autoscale_metrics.go` and `cmd/levelrail-agent/main.go` are plausible importers, but the index doesn't show whether they use the package. If you allow the grep for `/internal/autoscale"` (or tell me to use the Grep tool), I can give you the definitive list.
call_log: Bash stacklit query "which files import internal/autoscale" --budget 800
Bash stacklit impact autoscale.Controller --budget 1500; stacklit query "importers of package autoscale Controller Policy" --budget 1600 | grep -i "autoscale\""
Bash stacklit query "internal autoscale" --budget 1600 | grep -E '^[0-9]+\. |autoscale\.' | grep -v '^ *[0-9]*-*[0-9]* *func.*Autoscale(Path|Policy)' | head -80
